activities.title: Fill your Total Cost column and a grand total
activities.intro: Open your Lab3 Inventory file. Fill column E with formulas, not typed numbers, then add a grand total.

items: In E2 type =C2*D2 (or type =, click C2, type *, click D2), then press Enter.
Fill E2 down to E9: double-click the fill handle or drag it.
In E10 add the eight totals with +: =E2+E3+E4+E5+E6+E7+E8+E9
Click E2, E9 and E10 and read each formula bar. No typed numbers anywhere.

blocks.prompt: What is your grand total in E10?
Click E5. What formula does the formula bar show?
Optional: a screenshot of column E

help: Your cell shows C2*D2 as text? You forgot the = at the start.
A different grand total? Click down column E and read each formula bar. Usually one row was typed by hand or the fill missed a row.
Press Ctrl+` to show every formula at once. Press it again to go back.
